newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks open steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks open steady to higher.

text.p: U.S. stocks were generally steady at the opening on Thursday, with the Dow industrials a trace higher.
The Dow Jones industrial average was up two to 5,936, the NASDAQ Index up one to 1,237 and the S&P Index unchanged at 694.
New York Stock Exchange advances lagged declines by 409 to 438, while NASDAQ advances led declines by 916/735.
The long bond was up 6/32 to yield 6.83 percent.
